datasets.name: so_mail_kpis
datasets.query: SELECT campaign_id, COUNT(*) AS sd_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN keep_flag = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mail_count FROM IDENTIFIER(:catalog || '.' || :schema || '.gold_so_output') GROUP BY campaign_id

datasets.name: validation_top_combos
datasets.query: SELECT combo_id, model_a, model_b, auc, pppm_score FROM IDENTIFIER(:catalog || '.' || :schema || '.gold_validation_results') WHERE segment_id = 'ALL' ORDER BY auc DESC LIMIT 20

datasets.name: lol_grid
datasets.query: SELECT segment_id, decile, name_count, mean_rank_mix FROM IDENTIFIER(:catalog || '.' || :schema || '.gold_list_of_lists') ORDER BY segment_id, decile
